clauses.clause_label: Dual Licensing Options — non-commercial GPLv3 option
clauses.scope_note: Repository source code; the stated option is for non-commercial use, including academic purposes, under GPLv3. This clause does not supply GPLv3's terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use must be non-commercial and comply with the GPLv3 terms; those terms are referenced by URL but are not included in the supplied text.

clauses.clause_label: Dual Licensing Options — commercial license option
clauses.scope_note: Repository source code; commercial use is tied to obtaining a commercial license. The text does not provide that license's terms. Lines 11–14 identify contacts for commercial licensing.
clauses.condition_explanation: The predicate requires that a commercial license has been obtained; the supplied text does not specify its terms or establish that any user has obtained one.

coverage_notes: The supplied text references GPLv3 by URL but does not reproduce its conditions; no GPLv3-specific permissions or obligations beyond the stated non-commercial option are inferred.
Commercial license terms are not supplied. The contact information is not itself a grant or a complete set of conditions.
No operative terms are supplied here for copying, modification, distribution, sublicensing, combining, source provision, hosting/network access, fees, notices, patents, termination, or training.
